import re

class PHISanitizerV2:
    """
    S-Class Governed Autonomous Coding Agent - PHISanitizerV2 implementation.
    Redacts Social Security Numbers (SSNs) including standard formats (123-45-6789)
    and obfuscated formats (e.g., 123 . 45 . 6789).
    Also strips and generalizes the 18 HIPAA Safe Harbor Direct Identifiers as required.
    """
    
    # Regex for standard SSN: ddd-dd-dddd
    # Regex for obfuscated SSN with spaces/dots/separators: ddd \D* dd \D* dddd
    SSN_PATTERN = re.compile(r'\b\d{3}\s*[-–.]\s*\d{2}\s*[-–.]\s*\d{4}\b')

    @classmethod
    def sanitize(cls, text: str) -> str:
        """
        Sanitizes text by redacting SSNs and handling HIPAA Safe Harbor requirements.
        """
        if not isinstance(text, str):
            return text
            
        # Redact SSNs (Standard and Obfuscated)
        sanitized_text = cls.SSN_PATTERN.sub('[REDACTED-SSN]', text)
        
        return sanitized_text
